NAME
  sprint projects create — create server record

SYNOPSIS
  sprint projects create --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  create server record

EXAMPLES
  sprint projects create --file input.json

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --operation-key KEY
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output {data} on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  JSON payload: {"name":"string","icon?":"string","type?":"si | education | apartment | internal (preserve existing own/internal)","status?":"진행중 | 주의 | 완료 | 보류","onSite?":"상주 | 비상주","start?":"YYYY-MM-DD; creates native sprints on project creation","end?":"YYYY-MM-DD | empty for ongoing","member?":"manager stored name","po?":"product owner stored name","methodology?":"scrum | kanban | scrumban | predictive | hybrid","methodologyAnswers?":"object of native questionnaire answers including regulated boolean","methodologyRecommendation?":"native recommendation object","sprintLengthDays?":"integer 1..90","productGoal?":"string","description?":"string"}
